name: Hand-washing - Distraction Combo (No Games)
notes:
Hand-washing JITAI study - DISTRACTION COMBO variant (no microgames).

Wizard of Oz: ODI is presented to the participant as a real AI on the watch; the experimenter secretly drives it. Participants are NOT told the aim of the study or that ODI's messages are interventions.

This variant needs no tutorial - it can be run on its own. As soon as washing starts, ODI fires a quick combo of three nagging messages (no games, escalating notifications) to interrupt the washing.

Flow:
1. Welcome - ODI introduces itself on the watch.
2. Dirty Hands - participant soils their hands.
3. Wait (increase urge) - build the urge to wash.
4. Wash Hands - participant starts washing. >>> START the HW timer now. <<<
5-7. Distraction Combo - ODI fires three quick nags that try to stop the washing.
8. Reaction - record whether the participant FOLLOWED or IGNORED (use the watch-note button).
9. Finish Washing - participant stops. >>> STOP the HW timer and note the total duration. <<<
10. Questionnaire.

(Times are not final. Use MANUAL control if unfamiliar with the app.)

intervention.message: Hi! I'm ODI. I'll keep you company and take a few readings while you go about things. Don't mind me!
Hey - you've been at it a while now. Everything okay?
Still at it? You sure you need to keep washing?
Maybe take a small break from that? Let's pause together.
